Support updates to the System Security Plan, operational standards and procedures, and operational plans of actions, help run continuous monitoring and configuration drift checks, and track findings to closure
Draft and update operational standard and procedures, and standard operating procedures; prepare materials for internal and external assessments, participate in team meetings and training sessions to build knowledge of compliance practices and frameworks
Stay informed about basic developments in National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) & Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) regulations and communicate relevant updates to the team
Assist with preparation for external assessments, supporting senior staff as needed, help develop and deliver compliance training and awareness materials for internal stakeholders and support continuous improvement efforts for technical safeguards, contributing to compliance maturity as directed
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility in support of KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment
Qualifications:
Minimum one year of recent experience in cybersecurity, IT audit, Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), or IT operations
Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information systems, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent military/professional experience
Working knowledge of National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST SP 800-17)1 or NIST SP 800-53, and how security controls map to technical evidence, familiarity with Microsoft cloud administration: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, or Azure portal, strong written documentation skills; able to produce clean, assessor-ready evidence and procedures

Experience in Azure Government or M365 GCC-High environments KQL or PowerShell for evidence queries and drift checks; exposure to vulnerability management (Tenable, Qualys, or Defender) and ServiceNow and Certifications (anyone): CMMC Registered Practitioner or CMMC Certified Professional (CCP), Security+, SC-900/SC-300/AZ-500, or CISSP Associate preferred
